transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. I've called us together to discuss the first-year composition program's proposal to pilot an AI writing-feedback platform in two sections next term. As I understand it, the platform can generate comments on student drafts and can be configured for different levels of instructor control. Before I make a decision on whether this pilot may proceed and under what conditions, I'd like to hear from the writing program and the privacy office about any instructional or data-handling requirements we should be aware of. Could we start with the writing program's perspective on the proposal?

transcript.text: I should share that just this week, I finalized the writing program's adopted pilot standard for this platform. The standard permits the platform only for formative feedback, requires an instructor to review every generated suggestion before it is released to a student, and prohibits using the platform to assign or determine grades. This standard has not yet been added to the proposal packet, so I want to make sure everyone here is aware of it before we proceed.
